description: This file implements a terminal user interface (TUI) for the openclaw project, managing connection states, user interactions, and event handling for chat and agent sessions.

classes.name: TUI
classes.description: A class representing the terminal user interface, managing rendering and input handling.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the session key based on raw input, session scope, current agent ID, and main key.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Determines the initial agent ID for the session based on configuration, session input, and workspace.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Generates connection and activity status messages based on disconnect reason.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a function to deduplicate rapid backspace key presses within a specified window.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if an error is ignorable when stopping the TUI.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Stops the TUI safely, ignoring certain ignorable errors.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines the action to take on Ctrl+C based on input state and timing.

methods.name: runTui
methods.description: Main function to initialize and run the terminal user interface, managing connection, user input, and event handling.
